notes: Added twelve festive illustration backgrounds: Christmas with a tree, snowman, Santa hat and snowfall, Halloween with pumpkins, bats and a moon, Chinese New Year with lanterns and gold clouds, Mid-Autumn with a moon and rabbit, plus Valentine, Children's Day, New Year, Easter, Thanksgiving, Dragon Boat, Mother's Day and Father's Day.
